description: This file defines a Java interface 'WithMdcEntry' for logging utilities, specifying methods to add and remove diagnostic context entries to logging instances, facilitating MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management in logs.

classes.name: WithMdcEntry
classes.description: A generic interface for logger classes supporting MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries, providing methods to add and remove MDC entries with various overloads.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a single MDC entry identified by a key and value to the logger, returning the logger instance for chaining. Supports null values to remove entries.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds two MDC entries identified by key-value pairs to the logger, supporting chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds three MDC entries identified by key-value pairs to the logger, supporting chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries provided as MdcEntry objects to the logger, supporting chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes the MDC entry associated with the specified key from the logger, supporting chaining.
